title: Dongpo’s Braised Pork
synopsis: Dongpo’s Braised Pork is a traditional Hangzhou dish made from streaky pork.

fullText.simplified:
东坡肉

    东坡肉是一道中国传统名菜，在江南地区十分盛行。东坡肉在不同的地方有不同的做法。但所用材料基本相同，主料都是五花肉。肉会被切成方形小块，然后被整齐地摆放在盘中，红得透亮，色如玛瑙。夹起一块尝尝，软而不烂，肥而不腻。
    相传，东坡肉为北宋著名学者苏轼所创，因为苏轼号“东坡”，所以这道菜就以“东坡”命名。东坡肉富含人体所必需的脂肪、蛋白质，能够维持体温、保护内脏，为机体提供必需脂肪酸。但即便如此，食用它时也要记得适量。不然，过量的脂肪和蛋白质将给我们的身体带来负担。
fullText.traditional:
東坡肉

    東坡肉是一道中國傳統名菜，在江南地區十分盛行。東坡肉在不同的地方有不同的做法。但所用材料基本相同，主料都是五花肉。肉會被切成方形小塊，然後被整齊地擺放在盤中，紅得透亮，色如瑪瑙。夾起一塊嘗嘗，軟而不爛，肥而不膩。
    相傳，東坡肉為北宋著名學者蘇軾所創，因為蘇軾號“東坡”，所以這道菜就以“東坡”命名。東坡肉富含人體所必需的脂肪、蛋白質，能夠維持體溫、保護內臟，為機體提供必需脂肪酸。但即便如此，食用它時也要記得適量。不然，過量的脂肪和蛋白質將給我們的身體帶來負擔。

Otherwise, the excess fat and protein can become a burden for our bodies.

sentence_translations: Dongpo’s Braised Pork is a traditional Chinese dish which is very popular in the area south of Yangtze River.
The cooking method for Dongpo's Braised Pork differs by region.
But the ingredients used are basically the same, with streaky pork as the main ingredient.
The pork is cut into cubes and placed orderly on a plate, shining in transparent red like an agate gemstone.
If you pick up a piece and taste it, you will find that it is soft but not spoiled, and fat but not greasy.
It is said that Dongpo's Braised Pork was created by Su Shi, the famous Chinese scholar of the Northern Song Dynasty.
Because Su Shi's pen name was Dongpo, the dish was named after that.
Dongpo’s Braised Pork is full of fat and protein necessary for the human body.
It can maintain the body temperature, protect the internal organs and provides essential fatty acids.
Even so, you should remember to eat an appropriate amount.
Otherwise, the excess fat and protein can become a burden for our bodies.
